records.name: Centurion Defence Academy
records.description: Centurion Defence Academy in Lucknow is a prominent coaching and training institution for candidates preparing for NDA, CDS, AFCAT, SSB, and other defence services examinations. It provides structured coaching, personality development, and physical fitness training aligned with SSB interview requirements. The academy has produced hundreds of officers commissioned into the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.

records.name: Jindal Global Law School
records.description: Jindal Global Law School (JGLS) in Sonipat is India's most internationally oriented law school, part of O.P. Jindal Global University, and consistently ranked among India's top five law schools. It offers five-year B.A. LL.B. and B.B.A. LL.B. programs, LL.M., and Ph.D. degrees with strong faculties in international law, human rights, business law, and comparative law. JGLS has the largest number of international faculty among Indian law schools and maintains academic partnerships with over 200 universities worldwide.

records.name: Indian Institute of Drone Technology (IIDT)
records.description: Indian Institute of Drone Technology (IIDT) in Sehore, Madhya Pradesh is a specialized institution offering training and certification programs in drone operations, drone repair and maintenance, and drone entrepreneurship. As an RPTO (Remote Pilot Training Organisation) approved by DGCA, IIDT trains commercial drone pilots for agriculture, surveying, and logistics applications. The institute plays a role in developing drone technology skills in Central India, aligned with India's national drone policy goals.

records.name: Delhi Technological University
records.description: Delhi Technological University (DTU), formerly Delhi College of Engineering, is one of India's largest and most reputed state technical universities, established in 1941, offering B.Tech., M.Tech., MBA, and Ph.D. programs. It is consistently ranked among the top 15 engineering institutions in India and is particularly known for its electronics, computer science, and mechanical engineering programs. DTU's location in the national capital provides exceptional industry access, and its graduates are well placed in IT, consulting, PSUs, and startups.

records.name: TERI School of Advanced Studies
records.description: TERI School of Advanced Studies in New Delhi is an academic wing of The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI), offering M.Sc., M.Tech., MBA, and Ph.D. programs in energy, environment, natural resources management, and sustainable development. TERI's research legacy in climate change, clean energy, and sustainable development provides students unique exposure to cutting-edge policy and applied research. Graduates work in renewable energy companies, environmental consultancies, international development organizations, and policy research institutions.

records.name: Pavaman Aviation RPTO
records.description: Pavaman Aviation RPTO in Hyderabad is a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation offering commercial drone pilot certification programs for both small and medium category drones. The RPTO provides comprehensive ground school instruction and hands-on flight training in drone operations for agriculture, surveillance, photogrammetry, and inspection applications. Pavaman Aviation leverages Hyderabad's status as a growing drone hub to provide students with practical exposure to real-world drone deployment scenarios.

records.name: Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA)
records.description: Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA) in Manesar is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, offering postgraduate programs, certificate courses, and training in company law, corporate governance, insolvency, CSR, and competition law. It serves as the government's capacity building arm for corporate professionals, company secretaries, and IBBI (Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India) registered professionals. IICA has a growing international collaboration profile and plays a key role in India's corporate regulatory ecosystem.

records.name: TERI - The Energy and Resources Institute
records.description: The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) in New Delhi is India's foremost research organization in sustainable development, energy policy, clean technology, and environmental governance, with global influence through TERIIN and its subsidiaries. TERI conducts research across renewable energy, climate change adaptation, natural resource management, and clean transport, informing national and international policy. Through TERI School of Advanced Studies, TERI offers graduate and doctoral programs for students aspiring to careers in sustainability and development.
